column1: # Measured `go test -race -short -p 1` duration per package, in seconds.
# Generated from the shard test logs of a green CI run; used only to balance
# the shards of the `go-test-shard` job. Unknown packages fall back to the
# median weight, so a stale table degrades balance, never coverage.
# Observed after the first rebalanced run: 4:02/4:02/5:57/5:44 per shard, so this
# table still understates the per-package compile overhead of the larger shards.
# merge the per-package `ok  <pkg>  <seconds>s` lines of every shard log.
